summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SafeMedAI Iteration 2 features - PDF Report Export, Admin Scoring Configuration, Patient Profile Editing, and Settings with Audit Log & Notification preferences. Backend APIs working well (23/24 tests passed), frontend UI fully functional with all new features properly integrated.

minor_bugs.issue: Unauthenticated request returns 200 instead of 401 when session exists in different context

passed_tests: PDF Report Export: GET /api/reports/{result_id}/pdf returns valid PDF binary file
PDF Download button on Risk Results page (/results/:patientId) is clickable and functional
Admin Scoring Config page (/admin) loads with threshold settings and medication database
Backend API GET /api/admin/scoring-config returns current scoring configuration
Backend API PUT /api/admin/scoring-config/thresholds updates threshold values successfully
Backend API POST /api/admin/scoring-config/medications adds new medication entries
Backend API DELETE /api/admin/scoring-config/medications/{name} removes medications
Patient Profile editing: Edit button activates form mode with all patient fields
Patient Profile editing: Save button updates patient data via PUT /api/patients/{patient_id}
Settings page (/settings) loads with Notifications and Audit Log tabs
Notification Settings: Toggle switches save preferences via PUT /api/settings/notifications
Audit Log viewer shows paginated activity logs from GET /api/audit-logs
Sidebar navigation includes 'Scoring Config' link for practitioners
Sidebar navigation includes 'Settings' link for all users
Landing page still loads correctly with hero section and feature cards
Dashboard loads with seed data showing 3 patients and risk statistics
All existing MVP features continue to work (auth, patients, upload, processing, risk scoring, chat, alerts)
Role-based access control working for admin endpoints (403 for non-practitioners)
Patient profile shows updated emergency contact after edit and save
Risk Results page displays PDF download button with proper styling
Admin page shows medication database with Score 1, 2, and 3 categories
Settings page Audit Log tab shows activity entries with proper icons and timestamps
All new iteration 2 features properly integrated with existing authentication flow
